name: Thrush (Ayres) S2R
variants: Snow S-2 / Ag Commander / Thrush Commander (radial piston)
summary: Long-running family of single-engine agricultural aircraft, from radial-engined Thrush Commanders to modern turboprop Thrush 510s and 710s.

wings: Low, constant-chord wing with squared tips
Spray booms along the trailing edge
engines: Long slim turboprop nose with exhaust stacks on most; big round radial on older piston examples
fuselage: Large hopper ahead of a tall, upright cockpit with a boxy multi-pane canopy
Wire-cutter cable from canopy to fin
tail: Tall angular fin; strut-braced horizontal tail

tellTales: Single-engine low-wing taildragger with a tall, boxy cockpit behind a hopper
Spray booms along the wing trailing edge
Long slim turboprop nose, or a round radial on older examples

confusedWith.howToTell: The Thrush appears shorter and stockier with a tall, boxy multi-pane cockpit canopy; the Air Tractor usually shows a longer, higher-aspect-ratio wing and a leaner look.
The Thrush has a cantilever wing and a blunt radial or turbine nose; the Pawnee has a strut under each wing and a slim nose.
The Thrush is a cantilever monoplane with a blunt nose; the Cessna 188 has struts and a flat engine.
The Thrush is a monoplane; the Ag-Cat is a biplane.
The Thrush shares parts with the Dromader but is usually smaller; the PZL M-18 has the bigger ~1,000 hp radial and larger dimensions.
The Thrush is usually larger, with a bigger radial or turbine up front and a stouter fuselage; the Weatherly 620 is a smaller R-985 airframe.
